# beUI bar chart

Source: https://beui.dev/r/bar-chart (retrieved 2026-11-03).
Documentation: https://beui.dev/charts/bar-chart.

The bar chart and its transitive source dependencies are retained from the official
registry. Imports are relocated into this directory; the existing app `cn` helper
is reused. Preview-only files are omitted. These files remain TypeScript checked;
ESLint excludes upstream code because its hook patterns differ from this app’s
React compiler lint rules.
